summary_html: Manchester City has been owned since August 2008 by Abu Dhabi United Group for Development and Investment (ADUG), a private investment vehicle wholly owned by Sheikh Mansour bin Zayed Al Nahyan, Deputy Prime Minister of the United Arab Emirates. Since 2013, ADUG has held its stake in the club through City Football Group (CFG), a holding company that also owns stakes in a network of clubs worldwide. CFG was valued at roughly $4.8bn when Silver Lake made its original investment in November 2019.
